title: Lecture 9 — exponential, logarithmic, and hyperbolic functions
summary: Solve exponential and logarithmic equations with domain checks, then build hyperbolic functions from exponentials.
body:
The subscribed timetable records an SF1690 lecture on 16 September, 08:00–10:00 in W37. The saved HT26 plan assigns Calculus 3.2, 3.3 and 3.6, without derivatives or integral statements to Lecture 9. The Canvas course plan was checked on 21 September and matches the retained plan. This authored guide follows that plan; it is not a classroom transcript, and actual classroom coverage remains unverified.

Read the explanation, work through the two examples, then attempt the two self-checks before opening their answers. Exercise 9 links Calculus 3.2, page 175, exercises 1–18 and 25–30; 3.3, page 183, exercises 4, 6, 10, 12, 14, 15 and 18; and 3.6, page 205, exercises 2, 3 and 7. Exercise numbering follows the ninth edition. The linked tasks are recommended practice, not evidence of attendance or completion.
